articles.summary: TRAVERSE CITY, Mich. – January 26, 2026 – Following its Best of Show win at The Amelia Concours d’Elegance, the 1938 Alfa Romeo 8C 2900B has been named The Peninsula Classics Best of the Best 2025. Presented annually by The Peninsula Hotels, The Peninsula Classics Best of the Best Award brings together Best of Show winners from leading global concours and selects one vehicle as the overall recipient. The 2025 award was announced today at a private ceremony held […]
articles.title: The Amelia Concours-Winning 1938 Alfa Romeo 8C Earns The Peninsula Classics Best of the Best Award 2025 - Hagerty
